question_text: A stacked bar chart shows the expenditures (in millions of pesos) of four municipalities (Mun A, B, C, D) on three sectors: Health, Education, Infrastructure. For Mun D: Health=20, Education=30, Infrastructure=50. What is the total expenditure of Mun D?
